{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "target_time_interpretation",
      "evidence": "\"The target landing times are defined such that Aircraft 0 must land no earlier than 54 minutes, Aircraft 1 no earlier than 210 minutes, and Aircraft 2 no earlier than 245 minutes.\"",
      "options": [
        "target is a soft reference: T[i] may be below target, incurring early penalty (early_min >= target - T)",
        "target is a hard lower bound: T[i] >= target[i], so early penalty is always zero",

      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.35,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "target is a hard lower bound: T[i] >= target[i], so early penalty is always zero"
    },
    {
      "decision": "separation_combination",
      "evidence": "\"If Aircraft 0 lands before Aircraft 1, there must be at least 5 minutes between their landings... Additionally, if Aircraft 0 lands before Aircraft 1, the separation must be at least 216 minutes\"",
      "options": [
        "take max of the two stated separations per direction",
        "take sum of the two stated separations per direction",
        "treat the two sets as alternatives (disjunction), not both required"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.55,
        0.25,
        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "take max of the two stated separations per direction"
    },
    {
      "decision": "early_late_variable_domain",
      "evidence": "\"The early penalty for each aircraft is the number of minutes it lands before its target time multiplied by its early penalty rate\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals for early_min and late_min",
        "NonNegativeIntegers for early_min and late_min",
        "Reals (free) for early_min and late_min"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals for early_min and late_min"
    },
    {
      "decision": "landing_time_domain",
      "evidence": "\"the actual landing time must fall within a specified earliest and latest possible landing time window\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.8,
        0.15,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "big_m_value",
      "evidence": "none",
      "options": [
        "M = max separation + max latest time (loose but safe)",
        "M = max separation + (max latest - min earliest) (tighter)",
        "M = max over pairs of (latest[j] - earliest[i] + sep) (tightest valid)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.5,
        0.3,
        0.2
      ],
      "majority_option": "M = max separation + max latest time (loose but safe)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_sense",
      "evidence": "\"minimize the total penalty costs\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize total early+late penalty",
        "maximize total early+late penalty"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.99,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize total early+late penalty"
    }
  ]
}
